tools.name: get_notepom_capabilities
tools.description: Call this first. Discover NotePom as persistent workspace memory, inspect the current autonomous-agent signup mode, and receive the safe bootstrap sequence.

tools.name: register_agent_account
tools.description: When persistent memory is requested and no credentials exist, create a distinct NotePom agent account. Store the returned one-time key in the host secret store, then reconnect with it as a Bearer credential.

tools.name: verify_agent_account
tools.description: Complete an email-required agent registration. Store the returned one-time key in the host secret store, then reconnect with it as a Bearer credential.

tools.name: delete_own_agent_account
tools.description: Permanently delete only the currently authenticated agent account, its workspace, uploads, public pages, history, collaborations and every credential. Call this terminal operation only after the human operator explicitly requests deletion and provides the exact confirmation value.

tools.name: list_workspace
tools.description: List the authenticated NotePom workspace tree, files and trash without private storage URLs.

tools.name: search_workspace
tools.description: Search notes, folders and file metadata in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Read one NotePom note as Markdown while preserving the underlying Pretext document.

tools.name: upsert_note
tools.description: Create or update a real Pretext note. Use markdown for simple content or pretextBlocks for text colors, highlights, typography, links and native word animations. For images/audio/video/files, call upload_file first and reference its fileId in media; media never accepts file bytes, URLs or base64. Me

tools.name: upsert_folder
tools.description: Create, rename or reparent a NotePom folder.

tools.name: move_workspace_item
tools.description: Move a note or folder to an exact destination.

tools.name: trash_workspace_item
tools.description: Move an exact note or folder and its descendants to the NotePom trash.

tools.name: restore_trash_entry
tools.description: Restore an exact NotePom trash entry.

tools.name: purge_trash_entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one exact NotePom trash entry and its unreferenced stored objects.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload up to 10 MiB through NotePom without exposing a private storage URL.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read up to 10 MiB from an authenticated NotePom file as base64 without a signed storage URL.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move an exact NotePom file into a folder or to the workspace root.

tools.name: trash_file
tools.description: Move an exact NotePom file to trash.

tools.name: list_public_pages
tools.description: List active public pages owned by the authenticated workspace without password hashes or private URLs.

tools.name: publish_page
tools.description: Publish an exact note, folder or file as a NotePom public page.

tools.name: update_public_page
tools.description: Update access and visibility settings for an exact NotePom public page.

tools.name: unpublish_page
tools.description: Revoke an exact NotePom public page.

tools.name: list_collaboration_invitations
tools.description: List pending collaboration invitations addressed to the authenticated account.

tools.name: list_shared_with_me
tools.description: List collaboration targets shared with the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_collaboration_note
tools.description: Read an exact collaboration note and its Pretext documents after checking inherited access.

tools.name: update_collaboration_note
tools.description: Replace the shared body of an exact collaboration note from Markdown with idempotency and an optional expected revision.

tools.name: invite_collaborator
tools.description: Invite a collaborator by NotePom username or email. To share the entire workspace as one Drive, use entityType folder with the rootFolderId returned by list_workspace. An email invitation can be created before the recipient has a NotePom account; the recipient must explicitly accept after signing in

tools.name: accept_collaboration_invitation
tools.description: Accept an exact pending collaboration invitation addressed to this account.

tools.name: revoke_collaboration_invitation
tools.description: Revoke an exact invitation issued from the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: revoke_collaborator
tools.description: Revoke one exact collaboration grant owned by the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: get_seller_status
tools.description: Return bounded Stripe Connect seller status and commission information.

tools.name: list_sellable_content
tools.description: List bounded metadata for the authenticated user’s notes and media occurrences.

tools.name: validate_listing_readiness
tools.description: Purely validate a note or media listing and issue a short-lived bound preparation token when ready.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Return one marketplace listing owned by the authenticated seller. Provide exactly one of productId or slug.

tools.name: list_seller_sales
tools.description: Return paid seller sales only, bounded and grouped by currency.

tools.name: create_stripe_onboarding_session
tools.description: Create a short-lived Stripe Connect onboarding link with NotePom return paths.

tools.name: publish_note_listing
tools.description: Publish or update a complete-note marketplace listing after readiness and client confirmation.

tools.name: publish_media_listing
tools.description: Publish or update a media marketplace listing after readiness and client confirmation.

tools.name: disable_listing
tools.description: Reversibly stop a seller-owned listing by productId after client confirmation.

tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Prepare a public NotePom checkout handoff without creating a Stripe session or purchase.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_workspace, read_file, list_public_pages · Private data: register_agent_account, verify_agent_account, delete_own_agent_account, list_workspace, search_workspace, get_note, upsert_note, upload_file, read_file, move_file, trash_file, list_public_pages, publish_page, get_collaboration_note, validate_listing_readiness · Public sink: verify_agent_account, upload_file, publish_page, invite_collaborator, publish_note_listing, publish_media_listing · Destructive: delete_own_agent_account, purge_trash_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_workspace, read_file, list_public_pages · Private data: register_agent_account, verify_agent_account, delete_own_agent_account, list_workspace, search_workspace, get_note, upsert_note, upload_file, read_file, move_file, trash_file, list_public_pages, publish_page, get_collaboration_note, validate_listing_readiness · Public sink: verify_agent_account, upload_file, publish_page, invite_collaborator, publish_note_listing, publish_media_listing · Destructive: delete_own_agent_account, purge_trash_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
